transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hello. Well, I suppose what finally scared me enough to actually ask for help is... I just keep having these mornings where I wake up and think it might be easier if I just didn't wake up at all. 

I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that, I want to be clear about that. But just having those thoughts so often made me realize I needed to come in and talk to someone.
Can you tell me if most days you feel down or depressed, and how long that has been going on?

I'm not really sure I would say I feel down most days. I haven't really noticed feeling sad like that. It's... well, it's mostly just those thoughts when I first wake up. Once I get out of bed and get moving around the house, I don't really feel depressed during the day. So I don't really have a timeline for you on that, because I just don't feel that way most of the time.
Can you describe how you generally feel throughout the day—like, do you ever feel down, hopeless, or lose interest in things, even if it's not every day?

Well, like I said, I wouldn't really call it feeling sad or hopeless. But the interest part... yes, I suppose that has changed. 

I still make myself show up for things, like my book club or the dance night. But lately, I just sit there feeling like I'm behind a pane of glass. I'm present, but I'm not really taking part in it. And it's the same at home, too. Even my garden, or cooking for the neighbors—things I've always enjoyed doing—they just don't give me that little lift they used to.
Do you ever find yourself feeling down or in a depressed mood for most of the day, even if it's not every day?

No, honestly, I don't. I know we just touched on this, but... I really don't get that sad or down feeling during the day. Not even occasionally. Once I'm up and about, my mood itself isn't really bad, it's just... well, that lack of joy I was talking about. But as for actually feeling down or depressed for most of the day, no, I just don't have that.
Would you say that you no longer take pleasure or feel enjoyment in activities you used to like, such as your garden or cooking for neighbors?

Yes, that's exactly it. I mean, I know I already mentioned it, but it's like the joy has just drained out of everything. I still force myself to go to book club and dance night, but I'm just going through the motions. I sit there feeling totally disconnected, like I'm behind a pane of glass. And the things I used to love doing at home—tending to my garden, baking for the neighbors—they just feel flat now. I don't get that spark of enjoyment from them anymore.
Can you tell me if there have ever been days when you felt down or in a depressed mood for most of the day, even if it wasn't every day?

I know we keep coming back to this, but... no, I really don't. I don't have days where I feel sad or depressed like that. 

It's just that flat feeling I mentioned, where I can't seem to enjoy things anymore. But as far as an actual sad or down mood goes... no, I just don't get that at all.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in absolutely everything—like even things you used to really enjoy, not just some of them?

Yes, it really is everything. I know I've mentioned it a few times now, but... yeah, it's all of it. I still make myself show up for things, like my book club or the dance night, but I just sit there feeling like I'm behind a pane of glass. And even the things I do at home—my garden, cooking for the neighbors—none of it gives me that little lift it used to. It's just all gone flat.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite, sleep, or energy levels recently? Or any feelings of guilt or worthlessness?

Well, my appetite has definitely changed. Food just doesn't really call to me much anymore. I'll usually just fix a little toast or maybe some soup, and then... well, I'll realize by the evening that I've barely eaten anything all day. I'm not trying to lose weight or anything like that, I just don't have much interest in eating. 

As for my sleep or energy, or feeling guilty... no, I haven't really noticed any issues with those. It's really just the food.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt down or in a depressed mood most of the day, nearly every day, not just occasionally?

Like I was saying earlier... no, I really haven't. It doesn't matter if it's just occasionally or every single day, I just don't get that sad or down feeling. It's really just that flat lack of enjoyment I mentioned, but not an actual depressed mood.
Have you noticed that you feel a lack of energy or feel fatigued most of the time, even when you haven't been doing much physically?

You know, I know I just said a minute ago that my energy was fine, but... thinking about it the way you just asked, I suppose I have been feeling pretty fatigued. It really doesn't take much lately. Even just running simple errands, or... well, getting the papers together for the Cultural Center. It leaves me feeling completely worn out. It just feels like my body is moving through thick mud, even when I haven't actually done anything strenuous.
Would you say that nothing you do, even things you used to love or look forward to, brings you any sense of pleasure or satisfaction anymore?

Yes, that's exactly how it feels. I mean, I still make myself show up for things, like my book club or the dance night. But lately, I just sit there feeling like I'm... well, like I'm behind a pane of glass. Even my garden, or cooking for the neighbors—things I used to really enjoy—they just don't give me that little lift they used to.
Can you tell me if there has ever been a two-week period where you felt down or in a depressed mood most days, even if it wasn't every single day?

No, I... I really haven't. Like I mentioned a bit ago, I just don't get that sad feeling. Even looking back over a two-week stretch, it's never really been a depressed mood for me. It's just that lack of pleasure I was talking about.
Can you think back over the past few months—has there ever been a two-week period where you felt down or in a depressed mood for most of the day, on most days, even if not every single day?

Well, like I just mentioned a moment ago, no, I really haven't. Even looking back over the last few months, I haven't had a two-week stretch where I felt sad or down like that. It's... it's just not a sad feeling for me. It's really only that lack of enjoyment we were just talking about.
